title: 第二十七章 生存
content_zh:
第二十七章存在

    你的存在本来就是一个错，如果有人如此对你说，你的感觉是什么？

    如果你对自己说，我的存在本来就是一个错，更错的是，我明白了这是一个错，最错的是，我明白了这是一个错之后，还得继续错下去，这样的一生，是折磨，如果永生，那么将是永世的折磨，最大的悲剧。

    可是有一天，你因为某个原因忘记了这个错，那么你应该庆幸。

    结果你却为此而烦恼，付出一切都找回那个错。

    当艾妮尔跟着凯罗和维斯穿过长长的通道，来到下一站，也是第一次踏入地下的世界，不过这种进入并没有给艾妮尔带来什么特别的感觉，自失忆以来，她就没有再为任何事任何人有过激动，或者说兴奋，除了萨尔，可是对于他的感觉，即不是激动，也不是兴奋，而是怪异，艾妮尔并不想接近他，可是看到别人，比如爱夏接近他时，心里又很不是舒服，其实这种感觉连她自己都说不明道不明，她向来的观点就是，想要的就去拿就去得到，不想要的那么就扔了，连多看一眼也觉得浪费，可是对于他，对于这个一直在自己身边照顾自己的人，为什么不是如此呢？失去的那段记忆中，与他又是怎样的一种关系？艾妮尔时常会为此而烦恼，却又苦无结果。

    “咝！咝！”趁艾妮尔想心事这余，维斯发出蛇吐信子的声音。

    “怎么啦？”凯罗自然知道，维斯吐出这种声音的意思，回头用眼睛问道。

    “你觉得她真能帮我们消灭所有的变异生物？”维斯一路上都在观察前面这个女孩，虽然不弱，但也不可能强到能灭了所有的变异生物，要知道，每次对付变异生物，基地都得耗上所有的人力物力，齐心协力才能度过难关，近几年由于变异生物越来越强大，他们过关也显得越来越勉强，每一次都会有牺牲，而且牺牲的还都是些强者，至少是Ｄ区以上的贵族。

    “不知道！也许吧！”凯罗也一样看不透，这些新人，有人类，有贵族，还有一个奥维利斯都有兴趣的非人类，又非贵族，所以他只能相信，既然奥维利斯留下他们，那么他们一定有被留下的价值。

    “那你就带她去Ｄ区！”维斯不解。

    “如果她想去，早晚会去，现在我们带她去，还有机会看看她的实力。”凯罗自然不是个笨蛋，对于这种顺水推舟的事，乐的出一把力。

    “原来你是想看她的实力！”维斯这才明白过来，点了点头，“不过去了Ｄ区也不见的能看到她的实力！那里又不是变异生物的世界！”

    “可是那里有纱拉！”

    “呵呵～”维斯忍不住笑了两声，不过马上就捂住了自己的嘴，生怕被艾妮尔发现，不过艾妮尔并没有什么反应，她已经完全沉浸于自己的思维世界中。

    “不过……你最好不要高兴的太早，别忘了，你还欠纱拉一件好武器呢！”凯罗扬了下眉毛，好心的提醒道。

    “你……”一听这话，维斯心中的憧憬一下子变得无比灰暗，要知道，当初就是因为输给了这个纱拉，害得他无颜面对奥维利斯，无颜呆在Ｆ区，而且还输了自己的武器，还好上一次接受任务时，纱拉把武器还给了他，不过却要他找一件更好的来补，结果到现在他也没有找到，所以他是不去Ｄ区的，至少没有特别重要的事，纱拉在的时候，不去。

    “进不进？”站在最后的那道门前，凯罗给艾妮尔让了道，回头问道。

    “我……”维斯望了望前面已经出门的艾妮尔，在那做着思想斗争。

    “哼！”凯罗好笑的轻哼了一声，提步顾自走了进去，扔下进退两难的维斯。

    “喂！你就这样扔下我啊！”维斯不甘的在门外喊道。

    “谁让我没欠人家武器呢！”凯罗取笑道。

    “那是你没有勇气跟她比试！哼！说到底，你还不如我呢！”维斯愤愤不平的吼道。

    “可是你现在连进来的勇气都没有！”凯罗的声音渐渐远去，维斯抓着门把，最后用力一甩，还是跨了进去，就算今天纱拉要他的命，他也要去，这么好看的戏码，他怎么可以错过呢！

    “怎么不走了？”结果维斯一个瞬移，竟然撞上了面前突然停步的凯罗，收回脑袋直着脖子问。

    “……”结果对方没有任何的反应，就像傻了一样。

    “怎么……”结果维斯一抬头，双眼也直了，“这……”

    “这就是你们想要见识我实力的考场？”站在最前面的艾妮尔回头，嘴角带着一抹不易察觉的笑，“如果是，那么看来你们没机会见识到我的实力了。”

    “我……”凯罗也一样无法相信自己的眼睛，这是第一次让他有这种感觉，怎么说这里也是D区，上面贵族口中的高级贵族区，怎么可能会如此轻易的被血洗！

    “看来来应考的另有其人！不！也许不是人。”艾妮尔说着，提步走了进去，脚下所踏的完全是一条血路，散落的沙粒被粘稠的黑色浆体沾在了一起，伴着艾妮尔的每一次落脚与提步，发出一声声让人反胃的子嘎声，不过艾妮尔似乎感觉不到，因为她还在进一步的深入那血与沙的世界，似乎在前方有着特别的东西在等着她，所以她没有犹豫，到是身后的凯罗和维斯忍不住皱起了眉头，不停的吞着口水，竟力压着胃中的翻腾，向前跨出了两三步之后，又退了回去，贵族虽然是污染的造就，可是他们却有着干净的洁癖。

    “喂！”原以为艾妮尔只是走近去看看，结果她没有停下的意思，一直向前，最后推开了酒馆柜台后面的门，凯罗一急，大叫道，“你不能下去！下面不一样！”
content_en:
Chapter 27 Existence
Your existence is a mistake. If someone told you that, how would you feel?
If you say to yourself, my existence is a mistake. What is even worse is that I understand that this is a mistake. The worst thing is that after I understand that this is a mistake, I have to continue to make mistakes. Such a life is torture. If you live forever, it will be eternal torture, the greatest tragedy.
But one day, you forget this mistake for some reason, then you should be happy.
As a result, you end up worrying about it and doing everything you can to get that mistake back.
When Enel followed Kairo and Weiss through the long passage and came to the next stop, it was the first time she stepped into the underground world. However, this entry did not bring any special feeling to Enel. Since her amnesia, she had never been excited or excited about anything or anyone, except for Sal, but her feeling towards him was not excitement or excitement, but weird. EnelShe doesn't want to get close to him, but when she sees others, such as Ai Xia, approaching him, she feels very uncomfortable. In fact, even she herself can't explain this feeling. Her point of view has always been to get what you want and throw away what you don't want. Even looking at it feels like a waste. But for him, for this person who has always been by her side to take care of her, why isn't this the case?What kind of relationship was there with him in the lost memory?Enel often worries about this, but to no avail.
"His! His!" While Enel was thinking about something, Weiss made a sound like a snake spitting out a message.
"What's the matter?" Kailuo naturally knew what Weiss meant when he made this sound, and turned around and asked with his eyes.
"Do you think she can really help us eliminate all the mutant creatures?" Weiss was observing the girl in front of her along the way. Although she is not weak, she is not strong enough to destroy all the mutant creatures. You must know that every time the mutant creatures are dealt with, the base has to spend all its manpower and material resources and work together to overcome the difficulties. In recent years, as the mutant creatures have become more and more powerful, they have become more and more reluctant to pass the level. Every time there will be sacrifices, and the sacrifices are always strong ones, at least the nobles of District D and above.
"I don't know! Maybe!" Kailo also couldn't see clearly. These newcomers include humans, nobles, and a non-human being who Overlis is interested in, and they are not nobles. So he can only believe that since Overlis keeps them, then they must be worthy of being kept.
"Then take her to Area D!" Weiss was puzzled.
"If she wants to go, she will go sooner or later. Now that we take her there, we still have a chance to see her strength." Kailuo is naturally not an idiot, and he is happy to contribute to such smooth things.
"So you want to see her strength!" Weiss finally understood and nodded, "You can't see her strength without going to Area D! It's not a world of mutated creatures!"
"But there's Sara there!"
"Haha~" Weiss couldn't help but laugh twice, but immediately covered her mouth for fear of being discovered by Anel, but Anel did not react. She was completely immersed in her own thinking world.
"But... you'd better not be happy too early. Don't forget, you still owe Shala a good weapon!" Kailuo raised his eyebrows and reminded kindly.
"You..." Upon hearing this, the longing in Weiss's heart suddenly became extremely gloomy. You must know that it was because of losing to this Sara that he was embarrassed to face Ovilis and stay in Area F, and he also lost his own weapons.Fortunately, when he accepted the mission last time, Sara returned the weapon to him, but asked him to find a better one to replace it. As a result, he has not found it yet, so he will not go to Area D, at least not for anything particularly important, not when Sara is there.
"Can you get in?" Standing in front of the last door, Kailuo gave way to Enel and turned around to ask.
"I..." Weiss looked at Enel who had already gone out, struggling with her thoughts.
"Hmph!" Kailuo snorted in a funny tone, and walked in by himself, leaving Weiss in a dilemma.
"Hey! You just left me like this!" Weiss shouted outside the door unwillingly.
"Who said I don't owe anyone weapons!" Kailuo teased.
"That's because you don't have the courage to compete with her! Huh! After all, you are not as good as me!" Weiss shouted angrily.
"But you don't even have the courage to come in now!" Kailuo's voice gradually faded away. Weiss grabbed the door handle, gave it a final shake, and stepped in. Even if Shala wanted to kill him today, he would go. How could he miss such a beautiful show!
"Why don't you leave?" As a result, Weiss teleported and bumped into Kailuo who suddenly stopped in front of him. He pulled back his head and straightened his neck and asked.
"..." As a result, the other party didn't react at all, as if he was stupid.
"How..." As a result, Weiss raised his head and his eyes widened, "This..."
"Is this the examination room where you want to see my strength?" Enel, who was standing at the front, turned back with an imperceptible smile on her lips, "If so, then it seems that you have no chance to see my strength."
"I..." Kailuo couldn't believe his eyes either. This was the first time he felt this way. How could this be District D? How could the high-end noble district mentioned by the nobles above be so easily wiped out with blood!
"It seems that there is someone else here to take the exam! No! Maybe it's not a human being." Enel said, stepping in. The path she walked on was completely bloody, and the scattered sand was stained with sticky black slurry. With every footstep and step, Enel made a stomach-churning sound, but Enel seemed not to feel it, because she was still taking the next step.Stepping deeper into the world of blood and sand, it seemed that there was something special waiting for her in front, so she did not hesitate. When Cairo and Weiss behind her could not help but frown, they kept swallowing saliva, suppressing the churning in their stomachs, and took two or three steps forward before stepping back. Although nobles were created by pollution, they have a cleanliness.
"Hey!" I thought Enel was just walking closer to take a look, but she didn't mean to stop and kept moving forward. Finally, she pushed open the door behind the tavern counter. Kairo became anxious and shouted, "You can't go down! It's different down there!"
